source_facts.fact: At fixed y/reference, independent Exp1 thresholds drive integrated-hazard crossing. A finite crossing appends cumulative time T_n+s and post-bounce state S(Phi_s z); empty crossing stops at infinity. Zero normal uses identity reflection.

Ordered positive jump times enter the full finite-path density via iteration of independent clock factors and deterministic arc/bounce updates. A single finite-history extension is a source-implicit ingredient of this iteration, not the whole path law.

Flow/rate/reflection are jointly Borel; hazard continuous nondecreasing in time gives Borel crossings; each finite jump time/post-jump state is Borel in all deterministic parameters and clock sequence. Fixed finite-depth append therefore needs no nonexplosion assumption.
